title: Push
tagline: Push is a DAO analytics dashboard that details activity in the DAO
description: Push is a DAO analytics dashboard  that details activity in the DAO built using the Covalent API and React. Track token action, token holdings and price activity. I will continue building. A transaction flow of the DAO treasury  and governance activity is coming. This will be the next feature built using Parsiq https://twitter.com/owocki/status/1511818028173848576
how_its_made: It is made using the Covalent API. I used the endpoints to get token holdings - https://api.covalenthq.com/v1/1/tokens/{}/token_holders, to get price history - https://api.covalenthq.com/v1/1/address/{}/portfolio_v2and spot prices - https://api.covalenthq.com/v1/pricing/tickers/?quote-currency=USD&format=JSON&tickers=comp,eth,btc, I built the project using React, html , javascript and css.
